title: Compute Per-Run Cube Ledger and Known-Bad Cube Visibility
description: Read-only TPU7x cube ledger accounting: total cubes -> broken/tainted -> usable (HEALTHY + DEGRADED, named) -> DEGRADED subtracted if job pins HEALTHY -> job's own excluded pools -> cubes held by other queues -> free cubes for this run vs needed. Also checks whether known-bad pools are visible to the scheduler via cluster taints or only avoided by per-user NotIn lists.

workload_prefix.description: Workload or JobSet name prefix (e.g. train-8k).

excluded_pools.description: Comma-separated node pools excluded by the run's NotIn affinity.

needed_cubes.description: Number of 4x4x4 cubes required by the run (e.g. 128 for 8192 chips).

pins_healthy_only.description: Set to 'true' if the run pins 4x4x4-state=HEALTHY only.

nodes_file.description: Optional path to pre-fetched nodes JSON file.

holders_file.description: Optional path to pre-fetched held-cubes JSON file.
